description: Installs a validated compensated tomography-state table on one PA X000 or MPC320 polarization analyzer, optionally persists it on the DeviceOS host, and optionally applies a final compensated state.

polarizationAnalyzerDeviceId.description: PA X000 or MPC320 device identifier that owns the compensation table.

polarizationAnalyzerChannel.description: Analyzer channel. MPC320 supports only channel 1.

states.description: Complete compensated H/V/D/A/R/L table keyed by state and one-based waveplate or paddle number.

persist.description: Write the validated table to DeviceOS-local calibration storage after installation.

finalTomographyState.description: Optional compensated H/V/D/A/R/L state to apply after installation.

sourceReport.description: Optional provenance saved alongside the table on the DeviceOS host.

validationReport.description: Optional validation provenance persisted with the source report.

device.calibrationStore.applied.polariza.description: Installed analyzer compensation table, DeviceOS reply, optional final state, and DeviceOS-local persistence path.

device.calibrationStore.calibration.pers.description: DeviceOS-local path of the analyzer compensation table.
